mapper.insert: INSERT INTO log_audit ( actor_user_id, actor_user_type, actor_login_id, action, target_entity, target_id, request_uri, http_method, client_ip, user_agent, before_json, after_json, result, trace_id, logged_at, created_by, created_ip, created_at ) VALUES ( #{actorUserId}, #{actorUserType}, #{actorLoginId}, #{action}, #{targetEntity}, #{targetId}, #{requestUri}, #{httpMethod}, #{clientIp}, #{userAgent}, #{beforeJson}, #{afterJson}, COALESCE(#{result},'SUCCESS'), #{traceId}, COALESCE(#{loggedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), #{createdBy}, #{createdIp}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) )
mapper.sql: log_audit_id, actor_user_id, actor_user_type, actor_login_id, action, target_entity, target_id, request_uri, http_method, client_ip, user_agent, before_json, after_json, result, trace_id, logged_at, created_by, created_ip, created_at

WHERE logged_at >= #{search.dateFrom} AND logged_at < DATE_ADD(#{search.dateTo}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
AND ( action LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search.keyword}, '%') OR target_entity LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search.keyword}, '%') OR target_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search.keyword}, '%') OR actor_login_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search.keyword}, '%') OR client_ip LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search.keyword}, '%') )
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM log_audit
ORDER BY logged_at DESC LIMIT #{search.pageSize} OFFSET #{search.offset}
SELECT FROM log_audit WHERE log_audit_id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM log_audit WHERE trace_id = #{traceId} ORDER BY logged_at ASC LIMIT 200
